text.jp:
………………おや、セオドラか。
一人でどうしたんだい？
text.official_en:
Well, hello, Theodora. All alone today? Is something
the matter?

お前がなかなか戻らんから、探しに来たのだ。
何をしていた？

I noticed your absence and came looking for you.
Where have you been?

森の部族たちを相手するようにね。

The same work I do with the people of the forest.

しばらくは、大丈夫そうだ。

They're pressing on with their lives, despite
everything. Things are fine for now.

……そのようにして、
永い間、私たちを見守り続けていたわけか。

You have spent many, many years watching over
us this way.

before that.

今日まで栄えてきた間も、ずっとね。
text.official_en:
I was there for the fall of Damascar, and I was there
to see Saramis flourish to this very day.

I've seen people born, mature, and depart this life.
So trust me when I say you've become a fine queen.

have witnessed.

blink of an eye.
